nodes.label: The original twelve-assignment campaign failed with252615known model tokens plus8000unknown reserved tokens. Audited native descriptive scores for completed slots01/03/07 yield span-F1 0,0.4851076060791147,0.4790959549574731 and file-F1 0.28571428571428575,0.28571428571428575,1. Their cumulative exported-union span coverage is0.026696329254727477,0.3259620491526242,0.32739970594412937; final coverage is0,0.3259620491526242,0.3150073513967654. Final-selection-only repair cannot recover reference context absent from this confirmed union. Retrieval/delivery coverage is a supported investigation target, not proven architectural causality. No new model calls or accepted token savings; full campaign success remains false.

Two model and two tokenizer requests succeeded with zero retries/unknowns, consuming3001 known model tokens. The follow-up projected5007 tokens including reserves, delivered20 observations and returned all six required fields exactly. Retained-reasoning reservation was0, so the prospectively required positive-reasoning qualification failed. This supports limited encoded-payload interpretation, while fresh reasoning continuity remains untested.

Can a retrieval-first architecture or general source-delivery repair increase confirmed reference coverage and achieve perfect selected quality with15%total-model-token savings under the original8K matched comparison?
Can the fully integrated compact runtime satisfy perfect native benchmark quality and at least15% cumulative model-token savings against both fresh controls under8K?
Can a prospectively specified fresh workload exercise real retained reasoning under the unchanged GLM profile while compact evidence delivery and exact interpretation remain valid?
Factoring repeated source metadata reduces measured follow-up input while preserving every delivered observation.
